style: Top-down ocean life for the muted seafoam Tab Thursday interface. Transparent cutouts, restrained naturalistic editorial illustration, soft watercolor textures, no text or sticker borders.

assets.name: coral-fish
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent background sprite for a calm ocean-themed website viewed from above. A single small elegant reef fish, viewed strictly overhead from directly above, head pointing RIGHT, tail LEFT, gently curved body and delicate flowing fins. Muted terracotta and pale peach body with subtle ivory markings, translucent fins, soft naturalistic watercolor and gouache texture with refined fine detail. Flat soft diffuse lighting, quiet editorial illustration rather than a cartoon sticker or 3D toy. Entire fish fully visible, centered, occupying about 75 percent of the canvas, generous transparent space on every side. True transparent background. No water, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, white outline, frame, words, letters or watermark. Only one fish.
